req.title: PUT is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall produce the same terminal state when PUT is repeated with the same body for the same task_id.

doc.reasoning: The idempotency requirement for PUT /tasks/{task_id} means that issuing the same PUT request N times must yield the same terminal state as issuing it once. Tests must: (1) confirm a valid repeated PUT returns 200 with identical payload both times (positive/EP), (2) confirm a PUT to a non-existent task_id returns 404 consistently on every call (negative/NEG), (3) probe boundary task_ids (id=1 lowest seeded, id=20 highest seeded, id=21 just beyond) to catch off-by-one mutations (BVA), (4) verify that repeating a PUT that toggles 'completed' from false->true is idempotent (STC), and (5) verify that a full-field update repeated three times leaves the same state (DT). All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite DB per test via dependency override, ensuring determinism.

tests.name: test_put_idempotent_same_payload_twice_returns_identical_200
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists (title='Fix login bug', completed=false)
Database is pre-loaded with seed data
actions: POST PUT /tasks/7 with body {title:'Fix login bug updated', description:'new desc', completed:true}
Record response body R1 and status S1
POST PUT /tasks/7 with identical body again
Record response body R2 and status S2
trace: R-TASK-027: PUT is idempotent — same terminal state on repeated PUT
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base
from app import models

tf = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.db', delete=False)
tf.close()
DB_URL = f'sqlite:///{tf.name}'
engine2 = create_engine(DB_URL, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine2)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine2)
db2 = TestingSession()
db2.add(models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False))
db2.commit(); db2.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try: yield db
    finally: db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)
body = {'title': 'Fix login bug updated', 'description': 'new desc', 'completed': True}
r1 = client.put('/tasks/7', json=body)
r2 = client.put('/tasks/7', json=body)
assert r1.status_code == 200
assert r2.status_code == 200
d1, d2 = r1.json(), r2.json()
assert d1['id'] == 7
assert d1['title'] == 'Fix login bug updated'
assert d1['completed'] == True
assert d1['description'] == 'new desc'
assert d2['id'] == d1['id']
assert d2['title'] == d1['title']
assert d2['completed'] == d1['completed']
assert d2['description'] == d1['description']
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tf.name)

import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base
from app import models

tf = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.db', delete=False)
tf.close()
DB_URL = f'sqlite:///{tf.name}'
engine2 = create_engine(DB_URL, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine2)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine2)
db2 = TestingSession()
db2.add(models.Task(id=10, title='Organize desk', completed=False))
